svg.title: ONE PROFILE. EVERY CONTRIBUTION.
svg.desc: Illustrative public Donor profile for Example Donor Name in Example City, Example Country. Four distinct sample records: 100 PCS donated to Example Individual Name in Example City A, Example Country; 200 PCS donated to Example Charity Organization in Example City B, Example Country; three unpaid volunteer hours at that organisation; and a separate five-hour kitchen assistance shift there at USD 20 per hour, totalling USD 100 paid from appropriate separate funding. All participants, places, activities and amounts are illustrative placeholders.
svg.text: Direct donations to individuals and charity organisations, plus volunteer and paid service records.
Donations to individuals and charity organisations each have their own record.
